== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Imperial Navigation Charts (Errata)]] (<code>1281_32</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' text. No published image prints this version, so it was re-rendered in CardMaker (Batch B41b, Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026).

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee forum errata of 13 July 2012 (p739757).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on a Nar Shaddaa (Virtual Block 8)|Nar Shaddaa battleground site. If you control three Nar Shaddaa locations or just won a battle (or initiated a Force drain) here, 'steal' this Effect (relocate to your side of table). Place in Used Pile if opponent controls three Nar Shaddaa locations. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74). Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Read by eye after rendering.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
